activePlan.objective: Restore AI handoff policy compliance after two GitHub Copilot Autofix commits landed on development without updating DEVLOG.md/AI-HANDOFF.json.
steps: Confirm the AI handoff policy failure on 641cbac and 2d4abe9 is real and current: both are Copilot Autofix commits accepted directly on GitHub, each touching exactly one test file.
Read both diffs: each fixes a genuine CodeQL 'Incomplete string escaping or encoding' finding by replacing a dot-only regex escape with full metacharacter escaping in a RegExp built from a filename.
Confirm the fixes are correct and test-only (no production code path affected); keep them as-is rather than reverting.
Run the full local suite at the new tip to confirm nothing else broke.
Update DEVLOG.md and AI-HANDOFF.json to describe these two commits, satisfying the handoff policy, and push.

completed: Verified 641cbac (test/githubRepoSecurity.test.js) and 2d4abe9 (test/globalPolicy.test.js) each correctly fix a CodeQL-flagged incomplete-escaping bug: .replace(/\./g, '\\.') only escapes literal dots, not the full regex metacharacter set, when building a RegExp from an arbitrary filename constant.
Confirmed both are test-only changes with no production code impact.
This commit supplies the handoff update those two commits omitted, restoring AI handoff policy compliance without altering either fix.
verification: Full local suite passes 200/200 at the new tip (2d4abe9), confirming the two regex fixes introduced no regressions.
remaining: Push and confirm AI handoff policy (and Self-Test/CodeQL, unaffected by the underlying change) are green.
